bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR turned bullish, at the 30-day
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，逼近 30 日均线

read.en: Micron rose 5.9% on Oct 28 to $983.23, trading between $959.34 and $990. It is above the rising 5-day ($909.95), the falling 10-day ($907.44) and 100-day ($971.56) and the rising 200-day ($741.09), and below the falling 30-day ($997.26). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($849.25), and RSI is 53.
read.zh: 美光 10月28日上涨 5.9%，收于 $983.23，盘中区间 $959.34–990。股价位于上行的 5 日（$909.95）、下行的 10 日（$907.44）和 100 日均线（$971.56）以及上行的 200 日均线（$741.09）上方，低于下行的 30 日均线（$997.26）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$849.25），RSI 为 53。

read.en: The jump cleared $936–953.6 (Oct 27 and 13 highs) and the 100-day ($971.6), now support, and flipped the SAR bullish. Resistance is $990–997 (Oct 28 high, 30-day), then $1,011.8 (Jul 23 high) and $1,036–1,042 (Aug 17 and Sep 9 highs). Support is $959–971.6 (Oct 28 low, 100-day), then $936–953.6 and $907–910 (5 and 10-day). A close above $997 would target $1,012–1,042; below $959, $936–954.

s.en: Oct 27 high $935.9 and Oct 13 high $953.6, cleared
